articles.title: SpaceX deal to acquire spectrum license hammers shares of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile
articles.summary: Shares of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile tumbled in extended trading. SpaceX, which went public in June in a record IPO and is now valued at over $2 trillion, has relied on Starlink as its cash cow and only profitable business segment to date. For now, its space and artificial intelligence units are losing money.

articles.title: Treasury yields are 'really, really high' but can come down soon, Bessent's new advisor says
articles.summary: Yields in the global bond market have been on a tear as expectations grow for central banks to hike interest rates and corporations keep borrowing money to build out artificial intelligence infrastructure. Central bank officials signaled this week that more increases could be coming before the end of the year. Fed funds futures traders anticipate a more than 82% likelihood that the central bank will next increase borrowing costs at its December meeting, according to CME's FedWatch tool.

articles.title: Why a Starbucks takeover of Chipotle would — and wouldn't — make sense for both companies
articles.summary: Starbucks has reportedly explored buying Chipotle Mexican Grill, but investors are split on whether the megadeal would make sense for both companies. The report sent Chipotle stock up about 7% in afternoon trading, while shares of Starbucks fell roughly 4%. It is not unusual for deal rumors to lower the potential acquirer's value and increase the target's share price, but investor reactions show that a prospective takeover comes with pros and cons for each side of the deal.

articles.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
articles.summary: Shares of Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other artificial intelligence names sank lower on Thursday after the market learned more details about OpenAI's revenue. The company is under pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation to investors as it gears up for what is widely expected to be a blockbuster IPO. In the interim, OpenAI is engaging in early stage discussions with investors about a potential new funding round.

articles.title: Treasury sanctions 17 tankers linked to Iran's 'shadow fleet' in economic pressure campaign
articles.summary: Treasury Department is sanctioning 17 additional vessels it says are connected to Iran's "shadow fleet" used to transport oil and gas out of the country, as Washington tries to choke Tehran's economy to end the war that began over seven months ago. has long said Iran uses illicit oil revenues to fund its regime and related terror proxies and hopes to cripple Tehran's economy by stemming that revenue.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield is little changed as Fed's Waller says more hikes needed, investors await 30-year auction
articles.summary: The yield on the 10-year Treasury was relatively unchanged on Thursday as traders digested comments from a top Federal Reserve official while awaiting another long-dated bond auction. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that more hikes are needed to bring inflation down after around 5-and-a-half years above the central bank's 2% target, but suggested rates did not need to rise immediately.
